claim: The analog bag was already framed as a holiday gift in 2025, for tweens, teens and adults.
excerpt: Summary: an analog bag is a tote full of non-digital crafts and games (watercolors, crosswords, instant cameras); suggested fillers include crochet kits, friendship bracelet kits and Polaroid cameras.
title: I'm Calling It: An 'Analog Bag' Is 2025's Hottest Holiday Gift for Tweens, Teens and Grown-Ups Too
